title: Video Wrap
shortDescription: Every team or visitor gets their own short video at the end: their route, their answers, their scores, and their photos, cut into a branded vertical clip that is ready to share.
longDescription: Turns the data and media collected during an experience into a personal video. Route maps, quiz answers, facts discovered on the way, challenge results, points, leaderboard positions, photos, and clips are placed into an animated template, and each team or visitor receives a finished video that tells their own version of the day. Vertical formats suit stories and reels, while landscape versions work for screens and recap emails. Templates, branding, music, languages, and the data shown are configurable, from a city trail recap to an event highlight reel or an animated statistics video. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Everyone Gets Their Own Film
highlights.description: No two videos are the same: each one shows the route, answers, and moments of that team or visitor, which makes it something people actually watch and keep.

highlights.title: Made to Be Shared
highlights.description: Vertical, branded, and short, the video is ready for stories and reels, so guests carry the client's brand into their own feeds.

highlights.title: The Experience Keeps Going
highlights.description: A video arriving after the event brings the day back, extending the experience well beyond the moment and giving the client a natural reason to follow up.

highlights.title: Remix the Recap
highlights.description: Add a personal message from the host, the best photo of the day as the closing shot, a team versus team comparison, or a teaser for the next event at the end.

highlights.title: A Video for Every Story
highlights.description: Recap a city trail through political history, a team day with points for climate and karma, a festival in highlights, or a museum visit with every object the visitor discovered.

highlights.title: See Who Watches
highlights.description: Add a data layer that tracks deliveries, views, downloads, and shares per video, showing how far the recap travelled after the event.

highlights.title: Fed by the Whole Journey
highlights.description: Pair with Trail / Scavenger Hunt as the source of the route and challenges, with Journey Manager to collect each visitor's journey, with Memory Catcher or Connected Photographer for the photos, or with Journey Recap to send the video in a personal summary.
